## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(conflicted)
library(dplyr)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
library(gt)
library(here)
library(labelled)
library(purrr)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

incoming_dsci_major_students_survey_file <- here(
  "data",
  "raw",
  "incoming-dsci-major-students-survey.qs2"
)

dictionary_file <- here(
  "data",
  "raw",
  "incoming-dsci-major-students-survey-dictionary.qs2"
)

coded_responses_file <- here(
  "data",
  "raw",
  "incoming-dsci-major-students-survey.xlsx"
)

tabulate_coded_responses <- function(coded_survey, coded_response_column) {
  row_col_label <- coded_survey |>
    pull({{ coded_response_column }}) |>
    var_label()

  coded_survey_with_n <- coded_survey |>
    filter_out(is.na({{ coded_response_column }})) |>
    mutate(n = length(unique(response_id)), .by = cohort)

  n_for <- coded_survey_with_n |>
    distinct(cohort, n) |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = cohort,
      names_prefix = "cohort_",
      values_from = n
    ) |>
    transpose() |>
    list_transpose()

  coded_survey_with_n |>
    separate_longer_delim({{ coded_response_column }}, delim = "; ") |>
    drop_na({{ coded_response_column }}) |>
    count(cohort, n, {{ coded_response_column }}, sort = TRUE, name = "r") |>
    mutate(percent = r / n) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = cohort, values_from = c(n, r, percent)) |>
    relocate(ends_with("2025"), ends_with("2026"), .after = last_col()) |>
    gt(rowname_col = as_name(enquo(coded_response_column))) |>
    cols_add(dir = percent_2026 > percent_2025, .after = r_2025) |>
    fmt_tf(
      columns = dir,
      tf_style = "triangles",
      colors = c("green", "red")
    ) |>
    cols_label(
      dir = ""
    ) |>
    cols_merge_n_pct(
      col_n = r_2025,
      col_pct = percent_2025
    ) |>
    cols_merge_n_pct(
      col_n = r_2026,
      col_pct = percent_2026
    ) |>
    cols_hide(c(n_2025, n_2026)) |>
    cols_label(
      r_2025 = md(glue::glue("2025<br>*n* = {n_for$cohort_2025}<br>*r* (%)")),
      r_2026 = md(glue::glue("2026<br>*n* = {n_for$cohort_2026}<br>*r* (%)"))
    ) |>
    fmt_percent(columns = starts_with("percent"), decimals = 0) |>
    sub_missing(missing_text = "") |>
    # arrange({{ coded_response_column }}) |>
    tab_header(title = row_col_label) |>
    cols_label_with(fn = md)
}

tabulate_coded_responses_without_cohort <- function(
  coded_survey,
  coded_response_column
) {
  row_col_label <- coded_survey |>
    pull({{ coded_response_column }}) |>
    var_label()

  coded_survey_with_n <- coded_survey |>
    filter_out(is.na({{ coded_response_column }})) |>
    mutate(n = length(unique(response_id)))

  n_responses <- unique(coded_survey_with_n$n)

  coded_survey_with_n |>
    separate_longer_delim({{ coded_response_column }}, delim = "; ") |>
    drop_na({{ coded_response_column }}) |>
    count(n, {{ coded_response_column }}, sort = TRUE, name = "r") |>
    mutate(percent = r / n) |>
    # arrange({{ coded_response_column }}) |>
    gt(rowname_col = as_name(enquo(coded_response_column))) |>
    tab_header(title = row_col_label) |>
    cols_merge_n_pct(
      col_n = r,
      col_pct = percent
    ) |>
    cols_label(
      r = md(glue::glue("*n* = {n_responses}<br>*r* (%)"))
    ) |>
    cols_hide(n) |>
    fmt_percent(columns = percent, decimals = 0) |>
    cols_label_with(fn = md)
}

get_n_responses <- function(coded_survey, response_column) {
  coded_survey |>
    drop_na({{ response_column }}) |>
    nrow()
}
```

### Qualtrics survey data

This workflow assumes that you generated a [Qualtrics API key](https://api.qualtrics.com/ZG9jOjg3NjYzMg-api-key-authentication) and saved it securely with `keyring::key_set("qualtrics_api_key")` in your OS's secure secret store.
In addition, request access to the Qualtrics Data Science surveys from Stephan Koenig.

```{r}
#| label: qualtrics
#| eval: false
# Do only once per system
# keyring::key_set("qualtrics_api_key")
qualtRics::qualtrics_api_credentials(
  api_key = keyring::key_get("qualtrics_api_key"),
  base_url = "ubc.yul1.qualtrics.com"
)

surveys <- qualtRics::all_surveys()
incoming_dsci_major_students_survey_id <-
  surveys$id[surveys$name == "Incoming DSCI Major students survey"]
qualtRics::fetch_survey(
  incoming_dsci_major_students_survey_id,
  breakout_sets = FALSE
) |>
  qs2::qs_save(incoming_dsci_major_students_survey_file)
qualtRics::survey_questions(incoming_dsci_major_students_survey_id) |>
  qs2::qs_save(dictionary_file)

end_of_second_year_dsci_major_students_survey_id <- surveys$id[
  surveys$name == "DSCI 200: Mid-course survey"
]
qualtRics::fetch_survey(
  end_of_second_year_dsci_major_students_survey_id,
  breakout_sets = FALSE
) |>
  qs2::qs_save(end_of_second_year_dsci_major_students_survey_file)
qualtRics::survey_questions(end_of_second_year_dsci_major_students_survey_id) |>
  qs2::qs_save(end_of_second_year_dictionary_file)
```

Qualtrics delimiter for multiple selections (`,` surrounded by no spaces) was replaced with `; `
Survey responses were manually inspected and all responses with a `progress` of 89 or more are considered complete.
Full length questions were downloaded as a dictionary.

```{r}
#| label: load-data
incoming_students_survey <-
  qs2::qs_read(incoming_dsci_major_students_survey_file) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    q2 = str_replace_all(q2, "(?<=\\S),(?=\\S)", "; "),
    cohort = lubridate::year(recorded_date)
  )

completed_incoming_students_survey <- incoming_students_survey |>
  filter(progress >= 89)

dictionary <- qs2::qs_read(dictionary_file)
end_of_second_year_dictionary <- qs2::qs_read(
  end_of_second_year_dictionary_file
)
```

An Excel version of the data was also downloaded. For each open-ended question, a dedicated sheet was created (for example, sheet "q6" for question 6) and then responses were manually coded.
Multiple codes assigned to a response are separated by `; `.

```{r}
#| label: coded-responses
sheet_names <- str_c("q", 2:6)
coded_responses <- map(
  sheet_names,
  \(sheet) {
    read_xlsx(
      coded_responses_file,
      sheet = sheet,
      skip = 1
    ) |>
      janitor::clean_names()
  }
) |>
  reduce(
    \(x, y) {
      full_join(
        x,
        y,
        by = join_by(
          response_id
        ),
        relationship = "one-to-one"
      )
    }
  )

full_questions <- dictionary |>
  mutate(qname = str_to_lower(qname)) |>
  dictionary_to_variable_labels(
    names_from = qname,
    labels_from = question
  )

coded_survey <- left_join(
  completed_incoming_students_survey,
  coded_responses,
  by = join_by(response_id)
) |>
  set_variable_labels(
    q2 = full_questions$q2,
    q3_coded = full_questions$q3,
    q4_coded = full_questions$q4,
    q5_coded = full_questions$q5,
    q6_coded = full_questions$q6
  )

N_for <- coded_survey |>
  select(cohort, response_id) |>
  count(cohort, name = "N") |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = cohort,
    names_prefix = "cohort_",
    values_from = N
  ) |>
  transpose() |>
  list_transpose()

end_of_second_year_survey <-
  qs2::qs_read(end_of_second_year_dsci_major_students_survey_file) |>
  janitor::clean_names()

end_of_second_year_dsci_major_students_survey <- end_of_second_year_survey |>
  filter(q24 == "Yes")

end_of_second_year_sheet_names <- str_c("q", 25:27)
end_of_second_year_coded_responses <- map(
  end_of_second_year_sheet_names,
  \(sheet) {
    read_xlsx(
      end_of_second_year_coded_responses_file,
      sheet = sheet,
      skip = 1
    ) |>
      janitor::clean_names()
  }
) |>
  reduce(
    \(x, y) {
      full_join(
        x,
        y,
        by = join_by(
          response_id
        ),
        relationship = "one-to-one"
      )
    }
  )

end_of_second_year_full_questions <- end_of_second_year_dictionary |>
  mutate(qname = str_to_lower(qname)) |>
  dictionary_to_variable_labels(
    names_from = qname,
    labels_from = question
  )

end_of_second_year_coded_survey <- left_join(
  end_of_second_year_dsci_major_students_survey,
  end_of_second_year_coded_responses,
  by = join_by(response_id)
) |>
  set_variable_labels(
    q25_coded = end_of_second_year_full_questions$q25,
    q26_coded = end_of_second_year_full_questions$q26,
    q27_coded = end_of_second_year_full_questions$q27
  )
```

## Incoming DSCI Major students survey

The Incoming DSCI Major students survey focused on capturing the experience of students navigating the program requirements, their reasons for selecting the program and any concerns about it and their interest in the co-op program.

### Questions

```{r}
#| label: incoming-questions
dictionary |>
  filter_out(qname %in% c("Q1", "Q9")) |>
  select(question) |>
  gt()
```

### Responses

::: {#tbl-information}
```{r}
#| label: information
coded_survey |>
  select(response_id, cohort, q2, q2_coded) |>
  separate_longer_delim(q2, delim = "; ") |>
  mutate(
    q2 = if_else(str_detect(q2, "Please"), q2_coded, q2),
    n = length(unique(response_id)),
    .by = cohort
  ) |>
  drop_na(q2) |>
  # Ensure that each respondent's coded open-ended responses is not redundant
  # and thus doubly reported with multiple-choice selections
  distinct(response_id, cohort, n, q2) |>
  count(cohort, n, q2, sort = TRUE, name = "r") |>
  mutate(percent = r / n) |>
  copy_labels_from(coded_survey) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = cohort, values_from = c(n, r, percent)) |>
  relocate(ends_with("2025"), ends_with("2026"), .after = last_col()) |>
  set_variable_labels(
    r_2025 = "$r$",
    r_2026 = "$r$",
    percent_2025 = "Percent of $n$",
    percent_2026 = "Percent of $n$"
  ) |>
  gt(rowname_col = "q2") |>
  tab_header(title = var_label(coded_survey$q2)) |>
  cols_add(dir = percent_2026 > percent_2025, .after = r_2025) |>
  fmt_tf(
    columns = dir,
    tf_style = "triangles",
    colors = c("green", "red")
  ) |>
  cols_label(
    dir = ""
  ) |>
  cols_merge_n_pct(
    col_n = r_2025,
    col_pct = percent_2025
  ) |>
  cols_merge_n_pct(
    col_n = r_2026,
    col_pct = percent_2026
  ) |>
  cols_hide(c(n_2025, n_2026)) |>
  cols_label(
    r_2025 = md("2025<br>*n* = 32<br>*r* (%)"),
    r_2026 = md("2026<br>*n* = 32<br>*r* (%)")
  ) |>
  fmt_percent(columns = starts_with("percent"), decimals = 0) |>
  sub_missing(missing_text = "") |>
  cols_label_with(fn = md) |>
  tab_row_group(
    label = "Other",
    rows = starts_with("Other:")
  )
```

Students' multiple answers and coded opend-ended ("Other") responses (respondents $N_{2025}$ = `{r} N_for$cohort_2025` and $N_{2026}$ = `{r} N_for$cohort_2026`).
:::

::: {#tbl-application-process}
```{r}
#| label: application-process
tabulate_coded_responses(coded_survey, q3_coded) |>
  tab_row_group(
    label = "Transfer students",
    rows = starts_with("Transfer students:")
  )
```

Students' coded opend-ended responses (respondents $N_{2025}$ = `{r} N_for$cohort_2025` and $N_{2026}$ = `{r} N_for$cohort_2026`).
"Transfer students" indicates answers from transfer students.
:::

::: {#tbl-ranking}
```{r}
#| label: ranking
tabulate_coded_responses(coded_survey, q4_coded)
```

Students' coded opend-ended responses (respondents $N_{2025}$ = `{r} N_for$cohort_2025` and $N_{2026}$ = `{r} N_for$cohort_2026`).
:::

::: {#tbl-interests}
```{r}
#| label: interests
tabulate_coded_responses(coded_survey, q5_coded) |>
  tab_row_group(
    label = "Skills",
    rows = starts_with("Skills:")
  )
```

Students' coded opend-ended response (respondents $N_{2025}$ = `{r} N_for$cohort_2025` and $N_{2026}$ = `{r} N_for$cohort_2026`).
"Skills" indicates responses denoting interest in learning that particular skill.
:::

::: {#tbl-concerns}
```{r}
#| label: concerns
tabulate_coded_responses(coded_survey, q6_coded)
```
Students' coded opend-ended responses  (respondents $N_{2025}$ = `{r} N_for$cohort_2025` and $N_{2026}$ = `{r} N_for$cohort_2026`).
:::

## End of second year DSCI Major students survey

The end of second year survey asked students about their prepardness for the second-year DSCI courses, how their interest in data science has evolved and how they will navigate future course selection.

### Questions

```{r}
#| label: second-year-exit-questions
end_of_second_year_dictionary |>
  filter(qname %in% c("Q25", "Q26", "Q27")) |>
  select(question) |>
  gt()

N_of_end_of_second_year_survey <- end_of_second_year_coded_survey$response_id |>
  unique() |>
  length()
```

### Responses

::: {#tbl-preparation-from-prereqs}
```{r}
#| label: preparation-from-prereqs
tabulate_coded_responses_without_cohort(
  end_of_second_year_coded_survey,
  q25_coded
)
```

Students' multiple answers and coded opend-ended responses (respondents $N$ = `{r} N_of_end_of_second_year_survey`).
:::

::: {#tbl-change-in-interest}
```{r}
#| label: change-in-interest
tabulate_coded_responses_without_cohort(
  end_of_second_year_coded_survey,
  q26_coded
)
```

Students' multiple answers and coded opend-ended responses (respondents $N$ = `{r} N_of_end_of_second_year_survey`).
:::

::: {#tbl-navigating-program}
```{r}
#| label: navigating-program
tabulate_coded_responses_without_cohort(
  end_of_second_year_coded_survey,
  q27_coded
)
```

Students' multiple answers and coded opend-ended responses (respondents $N$ = `{r} N_of_end_of_second_year_survey`).
:::
